skip_case_attribution.case_level_explanation_method: Remote immutable-revision AST/source guards correlated with Linux skipped=3 and Windows skipped=0; source attribution is distinguished from direct per-case runtime output.

boundaries: Artifact existence alone is not full CI success.
Push fixed-tree and PR merge-tree counts are reported separately.
No assertion that a package-build smoke proves installer startup, signed-update installation, real GPU generation, or paid-service behavior.
No assertion that CI success completes the independent product audits or final external-cache cleanup.
